# Clean the charging contacts

[All care guides](README.md)

## Roomba 600 and 700 series · Roomba 800 and 900 series

![Clean the charging contacts](../img/underside_600_900--contact.svg)

![Clean the charging contacts](../img/home_base--contact.svg)

**What it does**

The charging contacts on the robot and on the dock carry the charging current. A film on them interrupts charging.

**How to**

1. Lift the robot off the dock.
2. Rub the robot's charging contacts with a slightly damp melamine sponge or cloth until they shine.
3. Unplug the Home Base for 60 seconds and clean its contacts the same way. Wipe its docking sensor window with a dry cloth only.
4. Plug the Home Base back in and set the robot on it.

> **Note** Nothing abrasive and no metal tools. Contacts that are green, copper-coloured or sunk in are damaged: contact iRobot support.

## washing station: Roomba e, i and j series, Combo j · Prime robots and other models

![Clean the charging contacts](../img/underside_eij--contact.svg)

![Clean the charging contacts](../img/wash_dock--contact.svg)

**What it does**

The charging contacts on the robot and on the dock carry the charging current. A film on them interrupts charging.

**How to**

1. Lift the robot off the dock.
2. Rub the robot's charging contacts with a slightly damp melamine sponge or cloth until they shine.
3. Unplug the dock for 60 seconds. Wipe its contacts, the infrared window and the docking marker with a dry cloth only.
4. Plug the dock back in and set the robot on it.

> **Note** Nothing abrasive and no metal tools. Contacts that are green, copper-coloured or sunk in are damaged: contact iRobot support.
